_about: What the plugin's makers want people to know. The plugin fetches this file at most hourly and says what applies at the start of the next session; the person decides. latest_version and changes (from claude-code/CHANGES.md) are filled by publish.sh for the channel it publishes: stair on main, stair-dev on staging; each channel reads its own branch's copy. A notice: {id, kind: update|privacy|info, title, text, until?: YYYY-MM-DD, channel?: release|dev, privacy_notice_version?: for kind privacy}.

notices.title: What's new in stair-dev 0.11.1
notices.text: Updating is one step now: the plugin, the `stair` command and the plugin's Python environment move to the new version together. Details: https://github.com/StairAI/claude-plugins/blob/staging/plugins/stair-dev/CHANGES.md

changes.summary: Updating is one step now: the plugin, the `stair` command and the plugin's Python environment move to the new version together.
items: The `stair` command runs whichever version Claude Code has installed, so it no longer stays on an old one after an update. A command set up by an earlier version is switched over at the start of your next session.
When a version needs a newer ledger SDK, the plugin builds a fresh Python environment for it in the background, once, and removes the old one.

On macOS, recording now reaches the ledger: before, the upload after each turn did not start there, and the queued events could not be read. What waited on the machine is uploaded after your next turn.
The update notice says what changed, and Claude can tell you more when you ask.

changes.summary: Each turn records who started it: you, another session, a background task or a notice from the app. Sessions started from other sessions, forks and sub-agents are linked to where they came from.
items: A conversation forked in the app no longer uploads again the history it copied from the original.

changes.summary: The update notice refreshes the marketplace first, so the update finds the new version.
Accounts can be anonymous: no e-mail is needed to start, and `stair rl claim you@example.com` adds one later.
items: At the start of a session the plugin tells you when a new version or a changed privacy notice is out.
